metadata.title: Hand-Drawn Red Eye Icon on Black

retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast minimalist graphic featuring a centered, hand-drawn red eye icon against a solid black background.
excludeWhen: clean vector lines without texture are required

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, primitive-style eye illustration rendered in a vibrant red with a textured, hand-painted stroke quality, set against a deep matte black field.
coreVisualRelationships: Red icon centered on a black field
Hand-drawn texture contrasting with flat background
Symmetrical lash arrangement around a circular iris
High-contrast color palette of red and black

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The eye icon is centrally located, occupying approximately 40% of the frame width.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The concentric circles of the iris and pupil serve as the central focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye draws the viewer directly to the center, with the radiating lashes leading the gaze outward and back in.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black negative space surrounds the central icon, emphasizing its isolation and importance.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation red against a zero-value black background creates maximum visual impact.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single bold sans-serif for utilitarian metadata.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the bold, condensed, and blocky nature of the metadata text.
Provides the necessary density and clean sans-serif structure.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a solid black square background with a centered, hand-drawn red eye icon. The eye should have a thick, textured stroke and radiating lashes.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add small, bold, red sans-serif text in the bottom right corner, arranged in a stacked rectangular block.

verificationChecks: Is the eye icon centered and red?
Does the eye have a hand-drawn, textured quality?
Is the text in the bottom right corner bold and red?

adjustableVariables: Scale of the eye icon relative to the frame
mustRedesign: Avoid clean, perfect vector circles for the eye
Do not use gradients or shadows on the icon

mustAchieve: High contrast between red and black
Visible 'hand-painted' texture in the red strokes
avoid: Off-center placement of the main icon

postGenerationChecks: Confirm the eye icon is the primary focal point.
Ensure the red color is vibrant and consistent.
Verify the background is a uniform, deep black.
Check that the hand-drawn texture is clearly visible.
Ensure the corner text is legible but unobtrusive.
recipe.reuseFormula: Centered [Subject Icon] in [Vibrant Color] with [Hand-drawn Texture] on [Solid Background Color] with [Metadata Text] in [Corner Position].
